cards.prompt_zh: 請等我一下。
cards.answer_en: Just give me a second.
cards.answer_zh: 請等我一下。
cards.original: Just wait me a second.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 請對方稍等時，用 give + 人 + 時間；wait 後面要接 for + 人。
grammar.pattern: Give me + 一段時間. / Wait for me + 一段時間.

cards.prompt_zh: 讓我調整一下設定。
cards.answer_en: Let me adjust my settings.
cards.answer_zh: 讓我調整一下設定。
cards.original: Let me change my setting.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 調整設定用 adjust settings；多項裝置設定通常用複數。
grammar.pattern: Let me adjust my + 複數名詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 你聽得清楚嗎？
cards.answer_en: Can you hear me clearly?
cards.answer_zh: 你聽得清楚嗎？
cards.original: Did you hear me fine?

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 詢問現在能否聽清楚，用 Can you hear me clearly?；clearly 修飾 hear。
grammar.pattern: Can you + 動詞 + 受詞 + 副詞?

cards.prompt_zh: 天氣非常熱。
cards.answer_en: The weather was extremely hot.
cards.answer_zh: 天氣非常熱。
cards.original: The weather is too hot.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 回顧當時天氣要用過去式 was；extremely 修飾形容詞 hot。
grammar.pattern: The weather was + 程度副詞 + 形容詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 它會直接通過台北。
cards.answer_en: It's going to pass directly through Taipei.
cards.answer_zh: 它會直接通過台北。
cards.original: It's directly just go through the Taipei.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 預測颱風路徑用 be going to + 原形動詞；地名前通常不加 the。
grammar.pattern: It is going to pass through + 地名.

cards.prompt_zh: 我剛注意到你換眼鏡了。
cards.answer_en: I just noticed that you changed your glasses.
cards.answer_zh: 我剛注意到你換眼鏡了。
cards.original: I just noticed you changed your glasses, right?

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: notice 後可接 that 子句描述觀察到的事；that 可省略。
grammar.pattern: I just noticed (that) + 主詞 + 過去式動詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 也許是螢幕品質造成這個問題。
cards.answer_en: Maybe the monitor quality caused the problem.
cards.answer_zh: 也許是螢幕品質造成這個問題。
cards.original: Maybe the monitor quality can cause this reason.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 描述可能的原因，用 cause + 問題；avoid cause this reason 這種重複表達。
grammar.pattern: Maybe + 原因 + caused + 問題.

cards.prompt_zh: 你的新員工目前怎麼樣？
cards.answer_en: How is your new staff member doing?
cards.answer_zh: 你的新員工目前怎麼樣？
cards.original: How about your new stuff or new employee?

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 關心某人適應得如何，用 How is + 人 + doing?；staff member 是一名員工。
grammar.pattern: How is your + 人 + doing?

cards.prompt_zh: 我真的很想睡覺。
cards.answer_en: I really feel like sleeping.
cards.answer_zh: 我真的很想睡覺。
cards.original: I feel really want to sleep.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 想做某事用 feel like + V-ing；feel want 不是自然搭配。
grammar.pattern: I feel like + V-ing.

cards.prompt_zh: 這真的讓我很驚訝，因為我從沒想過呼吸會影響記憶。
cards.answer_en: It really surprised me because I had never thought that breathing could affect our memory.
cards.answer_zh: 這真的讓我很驚訝，因為我從沒想過呼吸會影響記憶。
cards.original: I think it is really surprised to me because I never have a thought like thinking breath can affect our memories.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 主詞是事情時，用 It surprised me；更早的想法用 had never thought。
grammar.pattern: It surprised me because I had never thought that + 子句.

cards.prompt_zh: 讓我調整一下設定。
cards.answer_en: Let me adjust my settings.
cards.answer_zh: 讓我調整一下設定。
cards.original: Let me change my setting.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 調整設備設定用 adjust my settings；settings 通常是複數。
grammar.pattern: Let me adjust my + 複數名詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 你聽得清楚嗎？
cards.answer_en: Can you hear me clearly?
cards.answer_zh: 你聽得清楚嗎？
cards.original: Could you hear me fine?

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 檢查連線時用 Can you hear me clearly?；clearly 是副詞。
grammar.pattern: Can you + 動詞 + 受詞 + 副詞?

cards.prompt_zh: 我的意思是，老師教的是工程數學，對吧？
cards.answer_en: I mean, the teacher teaches engineering math, right?
cards.answer_zh: 我的意思是，老師教的是工程數學，對吧？
cards.original: I mean, because the class teachers, how to say teacher teach the engineering math, right?

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 先說核心主詞再補內容；單數 teacher 在一般現在式用 teaches。
grammar.pattern: The teacher teaches + 科目, right?

cards.prompt_zh: 每位老師教兩週，涵蓋兩個章節。
cards.answer_en: Each teacher teaches for two weeks and covers two chapters.
cards.answer_zh: 每位老師教兩週，涵蓋兩個章節。
cards.original: So one teacher teach two weeks and then two chapter.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: each + 單數名詞接單數動詞；說明授課期間與範圍可用 teaches for / covers。
grammar.pattern: Each + 單數名詞 + 動詞-s + for + 時間 + and + 動詞-s + 內容.

cards.prompt_zh: 我們平均分數要超過 70 分。
cards.answer_en: We need to get an average score above 70.
cards.answer_zh: 我們平均分數要超過 70 分。
cards.original: So we need to have, we need to got the average over 70.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: need to 後接原形動詞 get；成績高於某數字用 above。
grammar.pattern: We need to get an average score above + 數字.

cards.prompt_zh: 接下來五週的課可以延期嗎？
cards.answer_en: Would it be possible to postpone the classes scheduled for the next five weeks?
cards.answer_zh: 接下來五週的課可以延期嗎？
cards.original: Would it be possible how to say postpone about only these five weeks?

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 禮貌提出延期要求，用 Would it be possible to + 動詞；scheduled for the next five weeks 清楚指接下來五週原訂的課。
grammar.pattern: Would it be possible to postpone the classes scheduled for + 時間?

cards.prompt_zh: 我沒想到會這麼難。
cards.answer_en: I didn't imagine it would be this hard.
cards.answer_zh: 我沒想到會這麼難。
cards.original: I'm not imagine that is so hard.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 談之前的預期用 didn't imagine；would 表示從過去看未來的情況。
grammar.pattern: I didn't imagine it would be + 形容詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 這門課每人要 8,000 元。
cards.answer_en: This course costs 8,000 NTD per person.
cards.answer_zh: 這門課每人要 8,000 元。
cards.original: These course cost us one per people.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 單數 course 接 costs；說每人費用用 per person。
grammar.pattern: This course costs + 金額 + per person.

cards.prompt_zh: 我一直在考慮搬到另一個國家。
cards.answer_en: I have been considering relocating to another country.
cards.answer_zh: 我一直在考慮搬到另一個國家。
cards.original: I have been considering reallocating to other countries.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 搬到另一國是 relocate to；reallocate 指重新分配資源。
grammar.pattern: I have been considering + V-ing + to + 地點.

cards.prompt_zh: 我希望之後能帶給你一個好消息。
cards.answer_en: I hope I can bring you good news afterward.
cards.answer_zh: 我希望之後能帶給你一個好消息。
cards.original: I hope I can bring the green flag to you after.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 要說帶來好消息，用 bring + 人 + good news；green flag 不能直接代換。
grammar.pattern: I hope I can bring you good news + 時間副詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 你聽得清楚嗎？
cards.answer_en: Can you hear me clearly?
cards.answer_zh: 你聽得清楚嗎？
cards.original: Could you hear me fine?

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 音訊檢查用 Can you hear me clearly?；clearly 修飾 hear。
grammar.pattern: Can you hear me + 副詞?

cards.prompt_zh: 今晚我去牙醫那裡洗牙並檢查牙齒。
cards.answer_en: Tonight, I went to the dentist to have my teeth cleaned and checked.
cards.answer_zh: 今晚我去牙醫那裡洗牙並檢查牙齒。
cards.original: Tonight, I went to the dentist to wash my teeth and check my teeth.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 請牙醫處理牙齒可用 have + 受詞 + 過去分詞；cleaned and checked 平行。
grammar.pattern: I went to + 地點 + to have my + 名詞 + 過去分詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 好消息是我的牙齒很健康。
cards.answer_en: The good news is that my teeth are healthy.
cards.answer_zh: 好消息是我的牙齒很健康。
cards.original: Green flag is my tooth is healthy.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 引出好消息用 The good news is that + 完整子句。
grammar.pattern: The good news is that + 主詞 + 動詞 + 補語.

cards.prompt_zh: 之後我去健身房運動。
cards.answer_en: After that, I went to the gym and worked out.
cards.answer_zh: 之後我去健身房運動。
cards.original: After that, I go to the gym and do the workout.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 接續過去發生的兩件事，兩個動詞都用過去式；運動是 work out。
grammar.pattern: After that, I went to + 地點 + and + 過去式動詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 我又要過學生生活了。
cards.answer_en: I'll be a student again.
cards.answer_zh: 我又要過學生生活了。
cards.original: My life will return to student life.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 要說又要當學生，可直接用 I'll be a student again；again 表示再次。
grammar.pattern: I'll be a + 身分 + again.

cards.prompt_zh: 我的行程會很緊湊，因為我每週要去學校三次。
cards.answer_en: I will have a hectic schedule because I need to go to school three times a week.
cards.answer_zh: 我的行程會很緊湊，因為我每週要去學校三次。
cards.original: I will have a headache schedule because every thrice a week I need to go to school.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 忙碌的行程是 hectic schedule；每週三次是 three times a week。
grammar.pattern: I will have a hectic schedule because + 原因.

cards.prompt_zh: 你通常把冷氣設定在幾度？
cards.answer_en: What temperature do you usually set your air conditioner to?
cards.answer_zh: 你通常把冷氣設定在幾度？
cards.original: The temperature you setting, how do you always setting?

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 問設定的溫度，用 What temperature do you set + 設備 + to?。
grammar.pattern: What temperature do you usually set + 設備 + to?

cards.prompt_zh: 直到大約一個月前，我都沒有吃早餐的習慣。
cards.answer_en: Until about a month ago, I didn't eat breakfast.
cards.answer_zh: 直到大約一個月前，我都沒有吃早餐的習慣。
cards.original: I think one month ago, I don't eat breakfast.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 說明某個習慣持續到一個月前，用 Until about a month ago；過去的習慣用 didn't + 原形動詞。
grammar.pattern: Until about + 時間 + ago, I didn't + 原形動詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 所以我開始吃早餐。
cards.answer_en: So I started eating breakfast.
cards.answer_zh: 所以我開始吃早餐。
cards.original: So I start eat my breakfast.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: start 後可接 V-ing；已開始的習慣用 started。
grammar.pattern: I started + V-ing + 受詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 運動前應該吃一點輕食，幫自己補充能量。
cards.answer_en: Before working out, you should eat something light to give yourself energy.
cards.answer_zh: 運動前應該吃一點輕食，幫自己補充能量。
cards.original: Because when you go to the gym to do the workout, you need to eat some little thing to charge your energy.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 說明運動前吃點東西，先用 Before + V-ing，再說主要建議。
grammar.pattern: Before + V-ing, you should + 原形動詞 + to + 原形動詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 昨天是我新學期的第二天。
cards.answer_en: Yesterday was the second day of my new semester.
cards.answer_zh: 昨天是我新學期的第二天。
cards.original: yesterday is my second day from my new semester.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 過去時間用 was；學期中的第幾天用 of。
grammar.pattern: Yesterday was the + 序數 + day of + 名詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 我有兩門課要修。
cards.answer_en: I have two courses to take.
cards.answer_zh: 我有兩門課要修。
cards.original: I have two classes, two courses need to learn.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 修課用 take a course；避免重複 classes / courses。
grammar.pattern: I have + 數字 + courses to take.

cards.prompt_zh: 我剛剛又加選了一門課。
cards.answer_en: I've just added one more course.
cards.answer_zh: 我剛剛又加選了一門課。
cards.original: I just add one more course.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 剛完成的動作用 have just added；不是 add 原形。
grammar.pattern: I've just + 過去分詞 + 受詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 這門課的課業負擔很輕。
cards.answer_en: The workload for this course is really light.
cards.answer_zh: 這門課的課業負擔很輕。
cards.original: Loading is really light.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 課業負擔是 workload；loading 通常指載入。
grammar.pattern: The workload for + 課程 + is + 形容詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 我不覺得有壓力。
cards.answer_en: I don't feel stressed.
cards.answer_zh: 我不覺得有壓力。
cards.original: I don't feel stress.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 描述感受用 stressed；也可說 I don't feel much stress。
grammar.pattern: I don't feel + 形容詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 我對新學期仍然感到興奮。
cards.answer_en: I'm still excited about the new semester.
cards.answer_zh: 我對新學期仍然感到興奮。
cards.original: Right now, my condition still feel excited.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 用 I 當感受的主詞，再接 be + excited。
grammar.pattern: I'm still excited about + 名詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 我們以前念同一所高中。
cards.answer_en: We went to the same high school.
cards.answer_zh: 我們以前念同一所高中。
cards.original: We studied the same high school.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 就讀某校用 go to；也可用 studied at。
grammar.pattern: We went to the same + 學校類型.

cards.prompt_zh: 這就像一份夢寐以求的工作。
cards.answer_en: It's like a dream job.
cards.answer_zh: 這就像一份夢寐以求的工作。
cards.original: It is like a dream work

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 一份工作是 a job；work 在此是不可數名詞。
grammar.pattern: It's like a + 形容詞 + job.

cards.prompt_zh: 你聽得清楚嗎？還是聲音有延遲？
cards.answer_en: Can you hear me clearly, or is there a delay?
cards.answer_zh: 你聽得清楚嗎？還是聲音有延遲？
cards.original: Could you hear me fine or too late?

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 詢問現在的音訊用 can；too late 不等於網路延遲。
grammar.pattern: Can you hear me clearly, or is there + 名詞?

cards.prompt_zh: 你總是處在工作模式。
cards.answer_en: You're always in work mode.
cards.answer_zh: 你總是處在工作模式。
cards.original: You're always on the working mode.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 固定搭配是 in work mode，不用 on the working mode。
grammar.pattern: You're always in + 名詞 + mode.

cards.prompt_zh: 我會確保自己上課時不會太累。
cards.answer_en: I'll make sure I'm not too tired for class.
cards.answer_zh: 我會確保自己上課時不會太累。
cards.original: I will make sure I have, how to say, good condition.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 描述上課精神狀況，用 I'm not too tired 比 have good condition 自然；去掉找詞時的 how to say。
grammar.pattern: I'll make sure I'm + 形容詞 + for + 活動.

cards.prompt_zh: 我週六運動了。
cards.answer_en: I worked out on Saturday.
cards.answer_zh: 我週六運動了。
cards.original: I done my workout on Saturday.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 描述過去某天運動，用 worked out；有明確過去時間 on Saturday，動詞用過去式。
grammar.pattern: I + 過去式動詞 + on + 過去日期.

cards.prompt_zh: 但到頭來，你還是得找到自己的方向。
cards.answer_en: But in the end, you still need to find your way.
cards.answer_zh: 但到頭來，你還是得找到自己的方向。
cards.original: But at the end, you need to find your accurate... It's called... Your accurate direction, not always lost.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 這裡強調最後結果，用 in the end；find your way 在此是找到自己的方向，不是字面上的找路。
grammar.pattern: In the end, you still need to + 原形動詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 所以我當時在台中的麥當勞工作。
cards.answer_en: So I worked at McDonald's in Taichung.
cards.answer_zh: 所以我當時在台中的麥當勞工作。
cards.original: So I work McDonald's at Taichung.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 過去經歷用 worked；任職於店家用 at；城市前用 in。
grammar.pattern: I worked at + 公司 + in + 城市.

cards.prompt_zh: 當時有很多事情是我們必須做的。
cards.answer_en: There were a lot of things we had to do.
cards.answer_zh: 當時有很多事情是我們必須做的。
cards.original: Yeah, a lot of things we need to do.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 談之前的工作，用 There were ... we had to ...，讓句子有完整主幹並保持過去式。
grammar.pattern: There were + 複數名詞 + we had to + 原形動詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 我對這個比例並不太意外。
cards.answer_en: I'm not really surprised by the percentage.
cards.answer_zh: 我對這個比例並不太意外。
cards.original: Because I don't feel really surprised of the percentage.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 固定搭配 surprised by / at；獨立回答不必用 Because 開頭，也可另接完整原因。
grammar.pattern: I'm not surprised by + 名詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 我認為許多年輕人會用社群媒體找用餐地點。
cards.answer_en: I think many young people use social media to find places to eat.
cards.answer_zh: 我認為許多年輕人會用社群媒體找用餐地點。
cards.original: For the youngsters, I think they always use the social media to find a place to eat.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 一般說 social media 不加 the；young people 直接當主詞。many 比 always 的概括語氣保守。
grammar.pattern: I think many + 人群 + use + 工具 + to + 原形動詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 也許他們想變得更有名。
cards.answer_en: Maybe they want to become more famous.
cards.answer_zh: 也許他們想變得更有名。
cards.original: Yeah, maybe they want more famous.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: want 後不能直接接 more famous；要用 want to become / be + 形容詞。
grammar.pattern: They want to become + 形容詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 透過這個 App 訂餐很困難。
cards.answer_en: It's difficult to order food through the app.
cards.answer_zh: 透過這個 App 訂餐很困難。
cards.original: it's so hard to use the app to order the delivery.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 點外送可說 order food through the app 或 order food for delivery；避免不自然的 order the delivery。
grammar.pattern: It's difficult to + 原形動詞 + through + 管道.

cards.prompt_zh: 我們有足夠的時間學習課程內容。
cards.answer_en: We have enough time to learn the material.
cards.answer_zh: 我們有足夠的時間學習課程內容。
cards.original: we got enough time to learn the knowledge.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 描述現在課程用 have；學習教材內容用 learn the material，比 learn the knowledge 自然。
grammar.pattern: We have enough time to + 原形動詞 + 受詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 真的嗎？我看起來很有精神嗎？
cards.answer_en: Really? Do I look fresh?
cards.answer_zh: 真的嗎？我看起來很有精神嗎？
cards.original: Really? Am I look fresh?

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 一般現在式問句用 Do + 主詞 + 原形動詞。
grammar.pattern: Do + 主詞 + look + 形容詞?

cards.prompt_zh: 我這週學到了很多知識。
cards.answer_en: I've gained a lot of knowledge this week.
cards.answer_zh: 我這週學到了很多知識。
cards.original: I just learned a lot of knowledge this week.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: gain knowledge 是較自然的搭配；本週經驗可用現在完成式。
grammar.pattern: I've gained + 數量 + knowledge this week.

cards.prompt_zh: 我仍需要撥出一些時間複習學過的內容。
cards.answer_en: I still need to set aside some time to review what I've learned.
cards.answer_zh: 我仍需要撥出一些時間複習學過的內容。
cards.original: I still need to put another time to review or recall.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 用 set aside time 表示撥出時間；recall 通常需要受詞。
grammar.pattern: I need to set aside time to + 原形動詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 因為我這學期修了四門課，所以有很多內容要學。
cards.answer_en: Because I'm taking four courses, there is a lot I need to learn.
cards.answer_zh: 因為我這學期修了四門課，所以有很多內容要學。
cards.original: Because I chose four courses and then there has a lot of knowledge I need to learn.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 存在句用 there is；正在修課用 be taking courses。
grammar.pattern: Because I'm taking + 數字 + courses, there is a lot to learn.

cards.prompt_zh: 這能幫助我繼續進步，達到更高的程度。
cards.answer_en: It can help me move forward and reach a higher level.
cards.answer_zh: 這能幫助我繼續進步，達到更高的程度。
cards.original: It can help me to move forward to higher place, higher level.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: help + 受詞 + 原形動詞較精簡；reach a higher level 是自然搭配。
grammar.pattern: It can help me + 原形動詞 + and + 原形動詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 我還有週末可以補進度。
cards.answer_en: I still have the weekend to catch up.
cards.answer_zh: 我還有週末可以補進度。
cards.original: I still got weekend I can use.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 描述目前擁有的時間用 have；特定週末前加 the。
grammar.pattern: I still have + 時間 + to + 原形動詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 所以這表示可能只剩五分鐘。
cards.answer_en: So this means there may be only five minutes left.
cards.answer_zh: 所以這表示可能只剩五分鐘。
cards.original: So this is like maybe only left maybe five minutes.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 用 there may be ... left，並刪除重複的 maybe。
grammar.pattern: There may be only + 數量 + left.

cards.prompt_zh: 我改變了習慣，開始和最親近的朋友分享感受。
cards.answer_en: I've changed my habits and started sharing my feelings with my closest friends.
cards.answer_zh: 我改變了習慣，開始和最親近的朋友分享感受。
cards.original: I just changed my habits and started to share my feelings to my really close friends.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: share something with someone；closest 比 really close 更精簡。
grammar.pattern: I've started sharing + 事物 + with + 人.

cards.prompt_zh: 我大概有六、七成認同。
cards.answer_en: I'd say I agree with about 60 to 70 percent of that.
cards.answer_zh: 我大概有六、七成認同。
cards.original: I do maybe 60 to 70% agree.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 表達認同比例時，用 agree with about + 百分比 + of that；避免同時堆疊 to some extent、maybe 和 about。
grammar.pattern: I'd say I agree with about + 百分比 + of that.

cards.prompt_zh: 是的，真的很難把他們區分開來。
cards.answer_en: Yes, it's really hard to tell them apart.
cards.answer_zh: 是的，真的很難把他們區分開來。
cards.original: Yes, it's really hard to tell apart.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: tell apart 通常要指出被區分的對象，例如 tell them apart。
grammar.pattern: It's hard to tell + 受詞 + apart.

cards.prompt_zh: 我剛剛去健身房運動了。
cards.answer_en: I just went to the gym and worked out.
cards.answer_zh: 我剛剛去健身房運動了。
cards.original: I just went to the gym and do the workout.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 並列的過去動作時態要一致；do the workout 可簡化成 worked out。
grammar.pattern: I just went to + 地點 + and + 過去式動詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 喔，我也是。
cards.answer_en: Oh, same here.
cards.answer_zh: 喔，我也是。
cards.original: Oh, same to I.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 同意對方的個人經驗，用 Same here；same to I 不合英文用法。
grammar.pattern: Same here. / Me too.

cards.prompt_zh: 我想我需要兩天才能恢復。
cards.answer_en: I think I need two days to recover.
cards.answer_zh: 我想我需要兩天才能恢復。
cards.original: I think it needs two days to recover.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 需要時間恢復的人做主詞，用 I need；不是 it needs。
grammar.pattern: I think I need + 時間 + to + 原形動詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 我大約每個月看一次皮膚科醫師。
cards.answer_en: I see a dermatologist about once a month.
cards.answer_zh: 我大約每個月看一次皮膚科醫師。
cards.original: I will go to see dermatologist I think maybe once a month.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 描述固定看診頻率用一般現在式；專科醫師前加 a。
grammar.pattern: I see a + 專科醫師 + about once a + 時間單位.

cards.prompt_zh: 醫師說有些人會有這個問題。
cards.answer_en: The doctor said that some people have this issue.
cards.answer_zh: 醫師說有些人會有這個問題。
cards.original: The doctor just say some people will have this issue.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 轉述醫師當時說的話用 said；普遍情況可保留現在式 have。
grammar.pattern: The doctor said that + 主詞 + 現在式動詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 我從沒想過誰會搭飛機去高雄。
cards.answer_en: I never thought about who would take a flight to Kaohsiung.
cards.answer_zh: 我從沒想過誰會搭飛機去高雄。
cards.original: I never thought that who will take the airplane to Kaohsiung.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: thought about 後可接疑問詞子句；從過去視角推測用 would。
grammar.pattern: I never thought about who would + 原形動詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 在我看來，手機應該要能輕鬆單手操作。
cards.answer_en: In my view, a phone should be easy to use with one hand.
cards.answer_zh: 在我看來，手機應該要能輕鬆單手操作。
cards.original: In my view, I think phone, you just need to use your one hand.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 說功能需求可用 should be easy to + 動詞；with one hand 是自然搭配。
grammar.pattern: A + 物品 + should be easy to use with + 工具/方式.

cards.prompt_zh: 你甚至可以用同樣的價格同時買一支 iPhone 和一台 iPad。
cards.answer_en: You could buy both an iPhone and an iPad for the same price.
cards.answer_zh: 你甚至可以用同樣的價格同時買一支 iPhone 和一台 iPad。
cards.original: You also can buy an iPhone and iPad in the same time.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 比較價格用 for the same price；both A and B 連接兩項。
grammar.pattern: You could buy both + A + and + B + for the same price.

cards.prompt_zh: 我為什麼選擇 Apple Watch Ultra？
cards.answer_en: Why did I choose the Apple Watch Ultra?
cards.answer_zh: 我為什麼選擇 Apple Watch Ultra？
cards.original: Why I choose the Apple Watch Ultra?

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 過去的選擇問句用 Why did + 主詞 + 原形動詞。
grammar.pattern: Why did you choose + 物品?

cards.prompt_zh: 我沒買一般款 Apple Watch Series，主要是出於續航力的考量。
cards.answer_en: I didn't buy the regular Series model because of its battery life.
cards.answer_zh: 我沒買一般款 Apple Watch Series，主要是出於續航力的考量。
cards.original: I don't buy the normal series because the battery.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 因為某個名詞原因用 because of；過去沒買用 didn't buy。
grammar.pattern: I didn't buy + 物品 + because of + 名詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 我週二到週五有碩士課程。
cards.answer_en: I have classes for my master's degree from Tuesday to Friday.
cards.answer_zh: 我週二到週五有碩士課程。
cards.original: I have a master degrees class Tuesday to Friday, right?

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 碩士學位是 master's degree；從星期二到星期五用 from ... to ...。
grammar.pattern: I have classes for my + 學位 + from + 星期 + to + 星期.

cards.prompt_zh: 教授擔心我們仍得去學校上課。
cards.answer_en: The professor was worried that we would still have to go to campus for class.
cards.answer_zh: 教授擔心我們仍得去學校上課。
cards.original: The professor just worried about if our students still need to go to school to have a class,

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 擔心一件事用 worried that + 子句；到校上課是 go to campus for class。
grammar.pattern: Someone was worried that + 主詞 + would have to + 原形動詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 所以那堂課在九點結束。
cards.answer_en: So the class ended at nine o'clock.
cards.answer_zh: 所以那堂課在九點結束。
cards.original: so the course end at nine o'clock.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 描述過去結束時間用 ended；class 比 course 更適合單堂課。
grammar.pattern: The class ended at + 時間.

cards.prompt_zh: 我修了太多課。
cards.answer_en: I'm taking too many courses.
cards.answer_zh: 我修了太多課。
cards.original: Because too many course I need to learn. Attend.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 說這學期修太多課，用 I'm taking too many courses；too many 修飾可數複數。
grammar.pattern: I'm taking too many + 複數名詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 你們國家有保護龜類的法律嗎？
cards.answer_en: Does your country have laws to protect turtles?
cards.answer_zh: 你們國家有保護龜類的法律嗎？
cards.original: is your country have a law to protect the turtles?

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 一般現在式問句用 Does + 主詞 + have；does 後動詞不加 s。
grammar.pattern: Does your country have laws to + 原形動詞?

cards.prompt_zh: 是的，但我認為差異不大。
cards.answer_en: Yes, but I don't think it's very different.
cards.answer_zh: 是的，但我認為差異不大。
cards.original: Yeah, but I think it's not too much different

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 表達認為『不太』時，常用 I don't think + 肯定子句。
grammar.pattern: I don't think it is very + 形容詞.

cards.prompt_zh: Apple 曾推出 iPhone 9 嗎？我想沒有。
cards.answer_en: Did Apple ever release an iPhone 9? I don't think so.
cards.answer_zh: Apple 曾推出 iPhone 9 嗎？我想沒有。
cards.original: Because do Apple have the iPhone 9? I think no.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 過去是否曾發售，用 Did + 主詞 + ever + 原形動詞；簡答 I don't think so。
grammar.pattern: Did + 公司 + ever release + 產品?

cards.prompt_zh: 那兩台裝置合起來的價格大約和 iPhone Duo 一樣。
cards.answer_en: Together, those two devices would cost about the same as an iPhone Duo.
cards.answer_zh: 那兩台裝置合起來的價格大約和 iPhone Duo 一樣。
cards.original: Because these two things cost maybe equal to iPhone Duo.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 兩項總價相近，用 Together ... cost about the same as ...。
grammar.pattern: Together, + 兩項物品 + would cost about the same as + 比較物.

cards.prompt_zh: 但我想問：一心多用究竟是什麼？
cards.answer_en: But I really want to ask: what exactly is multitasking?
cards.answer_zh: 但我想問：一心多用究竟是什麼？
cards.original: But I really want to ask, what is exactly multitasking?

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 直接問句中疑問詞 exactly 放在 is 前：What exactly is ...?。
grammar.pattern: What exactly is + 名詞?

cards.prompt_zh: 我認為認識新朋友是拓展人脈的大好機會。
cards.answer_en: I think meeting new people is a great opportunity to expand your network.
cards.answer_zh: 我認為認識新朋友是拓展人脈的大好機會。
cards.original: because I think can meet new people, new friends is really a good opportunity to expand your network.

grammar.title: 句型重點
grammar.explanation: 動名詞片語作主詞時接單數 is；擴展人脈用 expand your network。
grammar.pattern: V-ing + 受詞 + is a good opportunity to + 原形動詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 請老師再解釋一次剛才的重點。
cards.question_en: Could you explain that one more time?
cards.answer_en: Of course. Let me put it another way.
cards.answer_zh: 當然。我換個方式說。

grammar.explanation: Could you + 原形動詞是禮貌請求；put it another way 表示換個說法。
grammar.pattern: Could you + 原形動詞 + one more time?

cards.prompt_zh: 詢問 handy 在句子中的意思。
cards.question_en: What does "handy" mean in this sentence?
cards.answer_en: It means convenient or easy to use in this context.
cards.answer_zh: 在這個語境裡，handy 是「方便、好用」的意思。

grammar.explanation: What does + 單數主詞 + mean?；in this context 指在此語境。
grammar.pattern: What does + 單字 + mean in this sentence?

cards.prompt_zh: 請老師示範發音，你再跟讀。
cards.question_en: Could you pronounce that word slowly?
cards.answer_en: Sure. Listen first, then repeat after me.
cards.answer_zh: 當然。先聽，再跟著我念。

grammar.explanation: Could you pronounce... 是禮貌的發音請求；slowly 是副詞。
grammar.pattern: Could you pronounce + 單字 + slowly?

cards.prompt_zh: 要求多一點時間組織答案。
cards.question_en: Do you need a moment to think?
cards.answer_en: Yes, please give me a second to organize my thoughts.
cards.answer_zh: 好，請給我一點時間整理想法。

grammar.explanation: give someone a second to + 動詞，表示給某人片刻做某事。
grammar.pattern: Please give me a second to + 原形動詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 確認對方能不能聽清楚你的聲音。
cards.question_en: Can you hear me clearly?
cards.answer_en: Yes, I can hear you clearly now.
cards.answer_zh: 可以，我現在聽得很清楚。

grammar.explanation: Can you hear me... 詢問即時音訊狀態；clearly 修飾 hear。
grammar.pattern: Can you hear me + 副詞?

cards.prompt_zh: 你聽到延遲，想確認對方是否也遇到。
cards.question_en: Is there a delay on your end?
cards.answer_en: Yes, your audio is about two seconds behind.
cards.answer_zh: 有，你的聲音大約延遲兩秒。

grammar.explanation: on your end 指你那端；behind 在這裡表示落後、延遲。
grammar.pattern: Is there a + 問題 + on your end?

cards.prompt_zh: 連線不穩，告知你要重新進入會議。
cards.question_en: Your connection seems unstable. Can you still hear me?
cards.answer_en: I can hear you, but I'll leave and rejoin the call.
cards.answer_zh: 我聽得到，但我會先離開再重新加入通話。

grammar.explanation: I'll + 原形動詞用於當下決定；leave and rejoin 是平行動詞。
grammar.pattern: I'll + 動詞 + and + 動詞 + the call.

cards.prompt_zh: 禮貌詢問是否可以把課往後延。
cards.question_en: Would it be possible to postpone our class?
cards.answer_en: Yes, we can move it to next Thursday.
cards.answer_zh: 可以，我們可以改到下週四。

grammar.explanation: Would it be possible to... 語氣比 Can we... 更委婉。
grammar.pattern: Would it be possible to + 原形動詞 + 活動?

cards.prompt_zh: 詢問對方下週何時有空。
cards.question_en: When are you available next week?
cards.answer_en: I'm available on Tuesday evening or Friday morning.
cards.answer_zh: 我週二晚上或週五早上有空。

grammar.explanation: available on + 星期；時間段可接 evening/morning。
grammar.pattern: I'm available on + 星期 + 時段.

cards.prompt_zh: 解釋因為學期忙碌，這週需要改期。
cards.question_en: Can we keep our usual class time this week?
cards.answer_en: I'm afraid I need to reschedule because my semester is busy.
cards.answer_zh: 恐怕我得改期，因為這學期比較忙。

grammar.explanation: I'm afraid... 可柔和地提出不便；because 後接完整原因子句。
grammar.pattern: I'm afraid I need to + 原形動詞 + because + 子句.

cards.prompt_zh: 告訴朋友你這學期修四門課。
cards.question_en: How many courses are you taking this semester?
cards.answer_en: I'm taking four courses, so my workload is quite heavy.
cards.answer_zh: 我這學期修四門課，所以課業負擔相當重。

grammar.explanation: be taking courses 描述本學期正在修的課；workload 指工作或課業量。
grammar.pattern: I'm taking + 數字 + courses, so + 結果.

cards.prompt_zh: 說明你要撥時間複習。
cards.question_en: How do you prepare for difficult classes?
cards.answer_en: I set aside time each weekend to review what I've learned.
cards.answer_zh: 我每週末會撥時間複習學過的內容。

grammar.explanation: set aside time to + 動詞表示保留時間；what I've learned 是名詞子句。
grammar.pattern: I set aside time to + 原形動詞 + what I've learned.

cards.prompt_zh: 向同事說明工作進度，並承諾稍後更新。
cards.question_en: How is the project going?
cards.answer_en: It's going well. I'll send you an update this afternoon.
cards.answer_zh: 進行得不錯。我今天下午會傳進度給你。

grammar.explanation: How is ... going? 問進度；send someone an update 是常見搭配。
grammar.pattern: I'll send you an update + 時間.

cards.prompt_zh: 請當地朋友推薦一道在地料理。
cards.question_en: What local dish would you recommend?
cards.answer_en: I'd recommend the noodle soup. It's a local favorite.
cards.answer_zh: 我推薦那道湯麵，是當地人很喜歡的料理。

grammar.explanation: would recommend 語氣禮貌；I'd recommend + 名詞。
grammar.pattern: I'd recommend + 料理 + because + 原因.

cards.prompt_zh: 在餐廳確認這道菜是否能外帶。
cards.question_en: Can I order this for takeout?
cards.answer_en: Yes, we can pack it for you.
cards.answer_zh: 可以，我們可以幫你打包。

grammar.explanation: for takeout 表示外帶；pack it for you 是幫你打包。
grammar.pattern: Can I order + 餐點 + for takeout?

cards.prompt_zh: 詢問餐廳有沒有特別優惠。
cards.question_en: Do you have any special deals today?
cards.answer_en: Yes, the lunch set is twenty percent off.
cards.answer_zh: 有，午間套餐打八折。

grammar.explanation: Do you have any... 適合詢問供應或優惠；percent off 表示折扣。
grammar.pattern: Do you have any + 複數名詞 + today?

cards.prompt_zh: 告訴朋友你運動後需要休息。
cards.question_en: Are you going to the gym again tomorrow?
cards.answer_en: Probably not. I need a day to recover after working out.
cards.answer_zh: 可能不會。我運動後需要一天恢復。

grammar.explanation: after + V-ing 表示做完某事之後；need a day to recover。
grammar.pattern: I need + 時間 + to recover after + V-ing.

cards.prompt_zh: 說明你剛去看牙醫並洗牙。
cards.question_en: How was your dental appointment?
cards.answer_en: It went well. I had my teeth cleaned and checked.
cards.answer_zh: 很順利。我洗了牙，也檢查了牙齒。

grammar.explanation: have + 受詞 + 過去分詞表示請別人替你做某事。
grammar.pattern: I had my + 名詞 + 過去分詞.

cards.prompt_zh: 對對方的看法表示部分同意。
cards.question_en: Do you agree with that idea?
cards.answer_en: I agree to some extent, but I see one problem with it.
cards.answer_zh: 我某種程度上同意，但我認為它有一個問題。

grammar.explanation: to some extent 表示部分同意；but 後接保留意見。
grammar.pattern: I agree to some extent, but + 子句.

cards.prompt_zh: 說明你對新學期心情複雜。
cards.question_en: How do you feel about the new semester?
cards.answer_en: I have mixed emotions. I'm excited, but also a little nervous.
cards.answer_zh: 我的心情很複雜。我很期待，但也有點緊張。

grammar.explanation: mixed emotions 表示同時有不同感受；I'm ... but also ... 列出兩種情緒。
grammar.pattern: I have mixed emotions. I'm + 感受 A + but also + 感受 B.
